layers.title: Layers

media.invalidRange: End must be later than start.
media.marksHint: Use the media controls in the viewer to set Mark In and Mark Out times.
media.editorHint: The waveform editor controls the source {type} only. Story narration is edited separately.

media.autoSaveHint: Preview the selection whenever needed. Dragged regions and exact time edits are saved automatically.

narration.title: Narration
narration.description: Choose the narration track and drag or resize the chapter region.
narration.dragSelection: Drag or resize the chapter selection
narration.footerHint: Use the WaveSurfer editor in the story-builder footer to adjust this range.
narration.editorHint: Choose audio and set this chapter's range in the narration editor.

position.hint: The frame drawn on the image is what readers see. Drag it there, set it from the view in the bar under the image, or type a region here.
position.empty: No frame yet. Pan and zoom, then set the frame.
position.aspectLocked: Story frame {aspect}. Preview and readers preserve this exact shape; width and height change together.
position.setFromViewHint: Use the current view as this chapter’s frame

annotations.emptySelection: Select an annotation from the list or artwork to edit its text and appearance.
annotations.hintSelect: Pick a shape to draw, or click an annotation on the image to edit it.
annotations.hintDraw: Draw the {shape} on the image. It opens in the Annotations panel when you finish.
annotations.hintEditing: Drag the annotation to move or resize it. Its text and colour are in the Annotations panel.

motion.title: Move through this chapter
motion.requireTwo: Choose a movement style or capture two keyframes to enable motion controls.
motion.requireOneMore: Capture one more keyframe to preview and configure this movement.
motion.durationError: Motion duration must be greater than 0 seconds.
motion.customHint: Custom keeps each keyframe as you captured it. Preview starts at keyframe 1.
motion.presetHint: Keyframes set where the camera looks; the movement style controls zoom. Resizing a keyframe switches to Custom. Preview starts at keyframe 1.
motion.dwellHint: Hold stationary on the initial view before movement starts.
motion.durationHint: Keyframes are spaced evenly across this movement time. The start hold is added before it.

cameraTimeline.title: Camera timeline
cameraTimeline.empty: No camera motion. Pan and zoom, then capture keyframes to add it.
cameraTimeline.captureHint: Add the current view as a keyframe
cameraTimeline.updateFromViewHint: Replace this keyframe with the current view
cameraTimeline.needSecond: Move the view and capture a second keyframe to create motion.
cameraTimeline.evenSpaceHint: Distribute all keyframes evenly across the duration
cameraTimeline.customTimingHint: Custom timing — drag markers on the track to align with narration.

settings.audioPreviewHint: Enter a URL to preview the narration track.
settings.draftIdentifiers: Without an AnnotationPage ID, Mango generates one under mangoviewer.dev. Exports stay valid IIIF, but set your own domain before publishing.
settings.presentationAspectHint: Locks every chapter frame and keyframe to one aspect ratio across all screens.
